mission.title: Interference
mission.description: Escort a medical courier to a wounded Zion operative.

npc.say: Well, you did as you said you would... maybe I misjudged you, {player}. I still think you're playing for the wrong team, though. The future of all humanity lies with Zion, not with some heartless machines! Think it over.
I don't think... I'm gonna... make it...
I--I think I'll be okay now. You saved my life. You ever need help, you come see me.

phase.briefing: The humans still do not trust us. To show them our good will, we intend to send operatives along to offer "protection." You will escort a medical courier, Mrkos, to a wounded Zion operative.

enter.say: You'll find the courier somewhere in that building. Keep a low profile.

talk.say: Unbelievable. I never thought I'd see the day that a fellow redpill was actually working for those damned Machines... Well, we don't have any time to waste. If our operative Bulgey doesn't get these special pills soon, he's a dead man. Let's go.

objective.text: Lead Mrkos out of the building

talk.say: I'm keeping one eye on you, {player}.

phase.briefing: Your waypoint is updated with the location of the damaged Zion operative. Get there quickly--the operative is surrounded by imposter Agent patrols.

enter.say: The badly wounded human operative Bulgey is somewhere in that building. Take Mrkos to him so that she can aid him with her medical supplies. Destroy any hostiles that you encounter.

done.say: Good work, you've taken care of all the imposter Agents in this area.
Mrkos has delivered the medication to Bulgey. Bulgey's life signs are stabilizing.
I--I think I'll be okay now. You saved my life. You ever need help, you come see me.

complete.say: You have completed all necessary tasks in the area, operative. You may leave now.

mission.finish: This distrust from the humans is a regrettable obstacle that we must continue to work against. How... comforting that we have an ally such as you to spread the word, {player}.
